tasks.short: Apply for environmental remediation project permits

steps.what: Identify actual permits, applicant authority and submission requirements for the remediation project's real scope and location
inputs: actual remediation scope/location
actual authority-issued permit requirements and applicant mandate
outputs: planner-checked permit requirements and authority limits

steps.what: Gather and check actual remediation drawings, site evidence and required permit attachments
inputs: planner-checked permit requirements and authority limits
actual project drawings, site studies and applicant records
outputs: checked actual permit evidence and attachment pack

steps.what: Complete and check the actual permit application fields, project statements, attachments and intended authority
inputs: checked actual permit evidence and attachment pack
planner-checked permit requirements and authority limits
outputs: complete checked remediation permit application and authority

steps.what: Submit the completed checked permit application to the intended permitting authority under the actual applicant mandate
inputs: complete checked remediation permit application and authority
outputs: submitted remediation permit application and receipt

tasks.design: Configure native project/attachment links in {OTHER}, the restoration project records application, and existing saved applicant fields in {GOV_PORTAL}. The planner determines requirements, gathers actual evidence and completes/checks the application before its separate authorised submission; substantive project statements remain manual.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated attachment navigation and fixed applicant/project fields can consume application effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document links and saved portal fields can reuse actual existing identities.
tasks.still_hard: Permit applicability and adequate project evidence depend on actual remediation scope.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a generic application omits a material site-specific effect.

ambition.what: No autonomous permitting or approval-success claim.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for applicant mandate, project records and portal permissions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native attachment links and saved applicant fields can reduce handling while permit applicability and final submission require authorised human judgment.

assumptions: Shares are provisional human application effort, not a measured baseline or prompt prior.
Project/site specialists supply actual drawings and studies; the applicant supplies identity/mandate; the planner checks and gathers them in s1/s2. Missing studies require real manual work.
Only existing fixed fields and source navigation change. No unproduced structured impact assessment or automatic legal interpretation is assumed; equivalent current configuration removes the gain.
Gross provisional saving 7.4 minus 1.5 hours of field/attachment upkeep gives 5.9 net. Submission is negligible and fully retained.

The planner has actual delegated applicant authority in this scenario and checks the final payload/recipient in s3. Otherwise existing applicant authorisation is required before submission; edits invalidate the gate.
unknowns: Actual portal saved fields and applicant authority
research_questions: Which real permit applications repeat fixed fields or attachment handling after native features?

already_counted.description: Gather/check evidence and complete/check the actual application

approvals.approved_version: complete checked remediation permit application and authority

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 5.9%; applicability, actual project statements and submission remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect active remediation sites for environmental and safety compliance

steps.what: Read actual site remediation conditions and applicable environmental/safety inspection policies, standards or regulations
inputs: actual active remediation scope and prior site records
actual applicable inspection criteria

steps.what: Inspect the active remediation site, observe actual work and assess environmental or safety compliance against the criteria
inputs: planner-checked site inspection context
actual active site, workers and measurements
outputs: actual site observations and planner's compliance findings

steps.what: Enter and check actual site observations, evidence references and compliance findings in the inspection record
inputs: actual site observations and planner's compliance findings
actual site/case identifiers and evidence files

steps.what: Save the completed checked active-remediation inspection record
inputs: complete checked active-remediation inspection record

tasks.design: Configure native case/criteria links and fixed site identity fields in {OTHER}, the remediation inspection application. The planner inspects actual conditions, writes/checks findings separately from fieldwork and saves the final record; no compliance finding or external notice is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated criteria navigation and fixed site identity entry can interrupt inspection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and fixed identifiers can reuse actual inspection context.
tasks.still_hard: Actual work conditions and evidential sufficiency require direct observation.
tasks.human_edge: Spot a site condition that a completed form would miss.

ambition.what: No automatic compliance certification or enforcement.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for site inspection and record permissions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native inspection references can reduce handling while actual site observation and compliance assessment remain human work.

assumptions: Shares describe an unmeasured actual inspection including its record; no added report is assumed.
Site/project owners supply actual identity and current scope; the planner obtains observations in s2 and records them in s3. No free structured observation feed is assumed.
Only navigation/fixed identity entry changes. Narrative findings and actual evidence capture remain retained; equivalent current fields remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 1.7 minus 0.5 hour of inspection-field upkeep gives 1.2 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.
The final record is checked during ordinary authoring. Actual urgent site instructions or notices, when required, remain real existing actions, not an automated design promise.
unknowns: Existing inspection form and evidence handling
research_questions: Is fixed identity or criteria handling still repeated in actual inspections?

already_counted.description: Read inspection criteria and complete/check actual findings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 1.2%; actual fieldwork and substantive record writing remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Study actual natural-resource conditions, environmental-planning objectives and applicable state/federal regulatory requirements
inputs: actual resource surveys and management objectives
actual authoritative planning/regulatory sources

steps.what: Develop the actual natural resource management strategy, actions, sequencing, monitoring approach and trade-offs
inputs: planner-checked natural-resource evidence and constraints
actual ecological and stakeholder needs
outputs: planner's natural-resource management decisions and rationale

steps.what: Write and check the actual natural resource management plan with evidence references, maps and limits
inputs: planner's natural-resource management decisions and rationale
planner-checked natural-resource evidence and constraints
outputs: complete checked natural resource management plan

steps.what: Save the completed checked natural resource management plan
inputs: complete checked natural resource management plan

tasks.design: Configure native resource/source views in {OTHER}, the GIS/resource records application, and linked map/reference fields in {DOCS}. The planner develops actual management actions and writes/checks the plan before saving; native configuration reuses references and maps rather than generating ecological strategy.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation and map/reference transfer can consume planning effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native GIS/document links can reuse actual resource evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Ecological objectives, competing uses and regulatory applicability need contextual judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Choose actions that acknowledge ecological uncertainty and real management constraints.

ambition.what: No automatic management-plan adoption or resource intervention.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for resource/GIS evidence and responsible planner consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native resource/map links can reduce handling while ecological management strategy and applicable requirements remain professional work.

assumptions: Shares are provisional plan-development effort, not measured environmental baselines.

Field teams provide actual surveys/maps; project owners provide objectives; authoritative publishers provide source text. The planner investigates missing evidence in s1 and determines applicability in s2.
Only navigation and fixed map/reference transfer change. Narrative actions, ecological reasoning and all review remain counted; equivalent native links remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 5.4 minus 1.25 hours of source/map-link upkeep gives 4.15 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.
The actual project jurisdiction determines sources; no current state/federal legal proposition is asserted here. Formal adoption or external submission remains a separate responsible process.
unknowns: Existing GIS/document links and actual planning constraints
research_questions: Does real plan writing repeat source/map handling beyond current native tools?

already_counted.description: Read resource evidence and complete/check the actual plan

incremental.description: Maintain resource and document map/reference links

approvals.approved_version: complete checked natural resource management plan

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 4.15%; actual management strategy and substantive plan writing remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify short- and long-term remediation impacts

steps.what: Characterize actual remediation activities, baseline environmental conditions and affected receptors
inputs: actual remediation activities and timing
actual site measurements, resource surveys and receptor evidence

steps.what: Identify plausible short- and long-term environmental impact pathways and select defensible assessment assumptions
inputs: planner-checked activity/receptor evidence and gaps
outputs: planner's impact pathways, time horizons and assessment assumptions

steps.what: Apply the selected environmental impact calculations/scenarios and inspect actual results for each time horizon
inputs: planner's impact pathways, time horizons and assessment assumptions
planner-checked activity/receptor evidence and gaps

steps.what: Interpret and complete the checked short- and long-term impact assessment with evidence limits and uncertainty
inputs: actual assessed remediation impact results
planner's impact pathways, time horizons and assessment assumptions

steps.what: Save the completed checked remediation impact assessment
inputs: complete checked remediation impact assessment

tasks.design: Configure native repeatable scenario profiles in {OTHER}, the environmental impact/GIS analysis application, and existing {SPREADSHEET} models. The planner defines actual pathways/time horizons, inspects results and completes the impact assessment before saving in {DOCS}; existing computational runtime earns no new gain.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated human scenario setup can interrupt impact assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Native profiles can reuse the planner's selected calculation structure.
tasks.still_hard: Long-term ecological response and indirect effects may remain poorly evidenced.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a calculated scenario from an established future impact.

ambition.what: No automatic environmental finding or impact magnitude claim.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for site evidence and analysis configuration access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native scenario profiles can reduce repeated setup while impact pathways and environmental interpretation remain expert judgments.

assumptions: Shares are unmeasured human impact-assessment effort, not a measured baseline.
Project teams supply activities/timing and field specialists supply actual environmental evidence. The planner investigates gaps in s1, chooses assumptions in s2 and supplies model inputs in s3.
No new structured receptor or sensor feed is assumed. Only repeated profile setup changes; current equivalent profiles remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 2 minus 0.75 hour of scenario-profile upkeep gives 1.25 net. Existing calculation execution and final save earn no new gain.
The final assessment is checked during interpretation/writing in s4; no additional report or external notice is introduced.
unknowns: Actual reusable scenario setup and evidence quality
research_questions: Does profile reuse save human setup after full input and result checks?

already_counted.description: Inspect scenario results and complete/check actual impact interpretation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 1.25%; pathway definition and substantive impact interpretation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
